name: Stream Tools
description: More control when watching streams in a call: auto-watch and auto-focus streams (full video without tapping, great with Only Show Videos), a bar on the stream to switch streams and change its volume, and a clean view that hides other tiles and the call controls. Switches in the call's menu.
author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")
contributors: il1ll (stream actions, Stream Button; adding a row to the call menu, Mute Bubble, GPL-3.0)
